arxiv-2102-10726.title: Quantum differential and difference equations for Hilb n ​ ( ℂ 2 ) \mathrm{Hilb}^{n}({\mathbb{C}}^{2}) .
arxiv-2102-10726.creator: Andrey Smirnov, asmirnov@email.unc.edu
arxiv-2102-10726.description: Abstract We consider the quantum difference equation of the Hilbert scheme of points in ℂ 2 {\mathbb{C}}^{2} . This equation is the K-theoretic generalization of the quantum differential equation discovered by A. Okounkov and R. Pandharipande in [ 27 ] . We obtain two explicit descriptions for the monodromy of these equations - representation-theoretic and algebro-geometric.

arxiv-2302-10449.title: Efficient phase-space generation for hadron collider event simulation Preprint: FERMILAB-PUB-23-032-T, MCNET-23-02
arxiv-2302-10449.creator: Enrico Bothmann, Taylor Childers, Walter Giele, Florian Herren, Stefan Höche, Joshua Isaacson, Max Knobbe, Rui Wang
arxiv-2302-10449.description: Abstract We present a simple yet efficient algorithm for phase-space integration at hadron colliders. Individual mappings consist of a single t-channel combined with any number of s-channel decays, and are constructed using diagrammatic information. The factorial growth in the number of channels is tamed by providing an option to limit the number of s-channel topologies.

arxiv-2401-16678.title: The Detection and Understanding of Fictional Discourse
arxiv-2401-16678.creator: Andrew Piper, Haiqi Zhou
arxiv-2401-16678.description: Abstract In this paper, we present a variety of classification experiments related to the task of fictional discourse detection. We utilize a diverse array of datasets, including contemporary professionally published fiction, historical fiction from the Hathi Trust, fanfiction, stories from Reddit, folk tales, GPT-generated stories, and anglophone world literature.

arxiv-2404-19616.title: Unified Framework of Forced Magnetic Reconnection and Alfvén Resonance
arxiv-2404-19616.creator: D. Urbanski, A. Tenerani, F. L. Waelbroeck
arxiv-2404-19616.description: Abstract A unified linear theory that includes forced reconnection as a particular case of Alfvén resonance is presented. We consider a generalized Taylor problem in which a sheared magnetic field is subject to a time-dependent boundary perturbation oscillating at frequency ω 0 \omega_{0} .

arxiv-2502-17640.title: Surfaces in 4 4 -manifolds and extendible mapping classes
arxiv-2502-17640.creator: Shital Lawande, Kuldeep Saha
arxiv-2502-17640.description: Abstract . We study smooth proper embeddings of compact orientable surfaces in compact orientable 4 4 -manifolds and elements in the mapping class group of that surface which are induced by diffeomorphisms of the ambient 4 4 -manifolds. We call such mapping classes extendible . An embedding for which all mapping classes are extendible is called flexible .

arxiv-2505-18545.title: B-score: Detecting biases in large language models using response history
arxiv-2505-18545.creator: An Vo, Mohammad Reza Taesiri, Daeyoung Kim, Anh Totti Nguyen
arxiv-2505-18545.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) often exhibit strong biases, e.g., against women or in favor of the number 7. We investigate whether LLMs would be able to output less biased answers when allowed to observe their prior answers to the same question in a multi-turn conversation.

arxiv-2508-01977.title: TIBSTC-CoT: A Multi-Domain Instruction Dataset for Chain-of-Thought Reasoning in Language Models
arxiv-2508-01977.creator: Fan Gao, Cheng Huang, Nyima Tashi, Yutong Liu, Xiangxiang Wang, Thupten Tsering, Ban Ma-bao, Renzeg Duojie, Gadeng Luosang, Rinchen Dongrub, Dorje Tashi, Xiao Feng, Hao Wang, Yongbin Yu
arxiv-2508-01977.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Fan Gao, Cheng Huang, Nyima Tashi, Yutong Liu, Xiangxiang Wang, Thupten Tsering, Ban Ma-bao, Renzeg Duojie, Gadeng Luosang, Rinchen Dongrub, Dorje Tashi, Xiao Feng, Hao Wang, Yongbin Yu. To address the severe data scarcity in Tibetan, a low-resource language spoken by over six million people, we introduce TIBSTC-CoT, the large-scale, multi-domain Tibetan dataset automatically constructed via chain-of-thought prompting with large language models (LLMs).

arxiv-2512-10769.title: Chemical enrichment in LINERs from MaNGA
arxiv-2512-10769.creator: Borja Pérez-Díaz, José M. Vílchez, Enrique Pérez-Montero, Igor A. Zinchenko, Brian Tapia-Contreras, Patricia B. Tissera
arxiv-2512-10769.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Borja Pérez-Díaz, José M. Vílchez, Enrique Pérez-Montero, Igor A. Zinchenko, Brian Tapia-Contreras, Patricia B. Tissera. Chemical abundance radial gradients provide key information on how the processes that affect chemical enrichment of the gas-phase interstellar medium (ISM) act at different galaxy scales.

pmc-10516795.title: Boron-doped diamond nanosheet volume-enriched screen-printed carbon electrodes: a platform for electroanalytical and impedimetric biosensor applications
pmc-10516795.creator: Mateusz Ficek, Mateusz Cieślik, Monika Janik, Mateusz Brodowski, Mirosław Sawczak, Robert Bogdanowicz, Jacek Ryl
pmc-10516795.description: This paper focuses on the development of a novel electrode based on boron-doped diamond nanosheet full-volume-enriched screen-printed carbon electrodes (BDDPE) for use as an impedimetric biosensor. Impedimetric biosensors offer high sensitivity and selectivity for virus detection, but their use as point-of-care devices is limited by the complexity of nanomaterials’ architecture and the receptor immobilisation procedures.

pmc-10654774.title: Cu(I)-thioether coordination complexes based on a chiral cyclic β-amino acid ligand
pmc-10654774.creator: Jihee Lee, Jaewook Kim, Hongil Jo, Danim Lim, Jungwoo Hong, Jintaek Gong, Kang Min Ok, Hee-Seung Lee
pmc-10654774.description: Coordination complexes, particularly metalloproteins, highlight the significance of metal-sulfur bonds in biological processes. Their unique attributes inspire efforts to synthetically reproduce these intricate metal-sulfur motifs. Here, we investigate the synthesis and characterization of copper(I)-thioether coordination complexes derived from copper(I) halides and the chiral cyclic β-amino acid trans-4-aminotetrahydrothiophene-3-carboxylic acid (ATTC), which present distinctive structural properties and ligand-to-metal ratios.

pmc-11444112.title: Ifosfamide-induced nephrogenic diabetes insipidus and Fanconi syndrome in a patient with femur osteosarcoma
pmc-11444112.creator: Marcio Concepción-Zavaleta, Guillermo Ramos-Torres, Juan Quiroz-Aldave, María del Carmen Durand-Vásquez, Sofía Ildefonso-Najarro, Elena de Jesús Alvarado-León, Francisca Zavaleta-Gutiérrez, Luis Concepción-Urteaga, José Paz-Ibarra
pmc-11444112.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundIfosfamide-induced Fanconi syndrome is a relatively infrequent complication that generally occurs in young patients with a high cumulative dose of ifosfamide; and is commonly characterized by glycosuria, proteinuria, electrolyte abnormalities, and a normal anion gap metabolic acidosis.Case Presentation: In this study, we present the case of a 16-year-old male patient with of osteosarcoma of the right femur with pulmonary metastasis, who received ifosfamide as part of chemotherapy 1 year and 2 months ago and required hospitalization for cellulitis.

pmc-11476724.title: Effects of 4 weeks of foot exercise on subjective outcome and foot plantar pressure in elite adolescent dancers with hallux valgus: a pilot study
pmc-11476724.creator: Zijian Liu, Yicheng Zhong, Shuo Chen, Hirofumi Tanaka, Yanshu Li, Hirofumi Katsutani, Takumi Okunuki, Hiroki Yabiku, Tsukasa Kumai
pmc-11476724.description: BackgroundDancers have a higher prevalence of hallux valgus (HV) than the general population. However, no reports specifically addressing treatment strategies for HV in dancers, or their effectiveness have been published. This study aimed to determine the effects of 4 weeks of foot exercises on subjective clinical outcomes, the HV angle, and change of foot plantar pressure during specific dance techniques.

pmc-11481371.title: Laparoscopic and thoracoscopic whole-stomach esophagectomy with preoperative pyloric balloon dilatation for esophageal cancer: a prospective multicenter case-series outcome
pmc-11481371.creator: Hoang Nguyen, Duc Huan Pham, Tuan Hiep Luong, Xuan Hoa Nguyen, Dang Hung Nguyen, An Khang Nguyen
pmc-11481371.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). pmc-11505273.title: Determinants of Fertility Intentions among South Koreans: Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
pmc-11505273.creator: Eungyung Kim, Jee-Seon Yi, Juan Carlos Sierra
pmc-11505273.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). (1) Background/objectives: This study aims to systematically review and conduct a meta-analysis of factors influencing fertility intentions among South Koreans. This research is crucial given South Korea’s lowest-in-the-world fertility rate of 0.72 in 2023, necessitating rapid and effective policies to address this demographic challenge; (2) Methods: Articles published from database inception through April 2024 were collected from five Korean databases using keywords based on the PEO (Population, Exposure, Outcome) framework. Following PRISMA guidelines, 35 articles were selected.

pmc-11647397.title: Socioeconomic inequality in cervical cancer screening uptake among women in sub-Saharan Africa: a decomposition analysis of Demographic and Health Survey data

pmc-12471685.title: Harmonic-Recycling Passive RF Energy Harvester with Integrated Power Management
pmc-12471685.creator: Ruijiao Li, Yuquan Hu, Hui Li, Haiyan Jin, Dan Liao, Zhaozheng Wang, Tianzhao Bu, Jianhua Zeng
pmc-12471685.description: The rapid growth of low-power Internet of Things (IoT) applications has created an urgent demand for compact, battery-free power solutions. However, most existing RF energy harvesters rely on active rectifiers, multi-phase topologies, or complex tuning networks, which increase circuit complexity and static power overhead while struggling to maintain high efficiency under microwatt-level inputs.

pmc-12501317.title: Comparative estimation of the spread of acute diarrhea and dengue in India using statistical mathematical and deep learning models
pmc-12501317.creator: Avaneesh Singh, Krishna Kumar Sharma, Kailash Wamanrao Kalare, Ashutosh Tripathi, Abhinav Sharma, Manish Kumar Bajpai
pmc-12501317.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). This study aims to forecast the spread of acute diarrhoea and dengue diseases in India by conducting a comparative analysis of statistical, mathematical (compartmental), and deep learning time series models. Utilizing weekly reported cases and fatalities from January 1, 2011, to Week 33, 2024, we evaluated ten forecasting techniques, including Regression, Bayesian Linear Regression with MultiOutputRegressor + XGBoost, SIR model, Prophet, N-BEATS, GluonTS, LSTM, Seq2Seq, and the ARIMA statistical model.

pmc-12509780.title: A Case-Based Report on Prosthetic Management of Anterior Tooth Loss in Children: Developmental vs. Acquired Causes
pmc-12509780.creator: Hulya Cerci Akcay, Cagan Tas, Eda Sir
pmc-12509780.description: Anterior tooth loss in children, whether arising from developmental anomalies such as congenital agenesis or acquired conditions like early childhood caries, can compromise oral function, facial esthetics, and psychosocial well-being. This case report presents the prosthetic rehabilitation of two pediatric patients with distinct etiologies of anterior tooth loss.

pmc-12603192.title: MARCH2-mediated Lys63-linked polyubiquitination promotes metastasis by modulating the catalytic activity of TGF-β type I receptor
pmc-12603192.creator: Kun Tae, Sang Woo Cho, Seonjeong Lee, Dahyoon Heo, Hyo Sun Cha, Da Yeon Lee, Eunjeong Oh, Minhyeong Choi, Donghyuk Shin, Siyoung Yang, Cheolju Lee, Cheol Yong Choi

pmc-12950070.title: Crude extract of cyanobacterium (Radiocystis fernandoi) triggers primary osmoregulatory impairment in the gills of nile tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus)
pmc-12950070.creator: Soares M.A.M., Pedrão P.G., Coelho J.P.S., Giani A., Fernandes M.N., Paulino M.G.
pmc-12950070.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). However, most toxicological studies still emphasize the isolated hepatoxicity of the MC-LR variant, with limited data on the toxicity of other variants or water exposure of the entire cellular contents released during cyanobacterial lysis.

pmc-13080082.title: Value of whole-process quality control management in central sterile supply department nursing practice and nosocomial infection prevention
pmc-13080082.creator: Fengjuan Wang, Na Zhao
pmc-13080082.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). A total of 300 medical instrument packs (including luminal devices) processed by the Sterilization Supply Center of Affiliated Hospital of Hebei University between January and June, 2025 were selected and randomly assigned, using a random number table, into a control group (n= 150) and an observation group (n = 150).

pmc-13276319.creator: Salma El Aouadi, Soukaina Bahha, Ouiam Taibi, Rania Bouanane, Nazik Allali, Latifa Chat, Siham El Haddad

pmc-13287298.title: Therapeutic Plasma Exchange in the Elderly: Rare Indications but Good Tolerability
pmc-13287298.creator: Valentin Coirier, Quentin Quelven, Pauline Guillot, Elie Jalaber, Floriane L’Her, Vincent Joussellin, Félicie Bélicard, Kieran Pinceaux, Adel Maamar, Mathieu Lesouhaitier, Jean‐Marc Tadié, Nicolas Terzi
pmc-13287298.description: Therapeutic plasma exchange (TPE) is used for a wide range of indications and is associated with well‐described adverse events. However, no study has specifically focused on tolerance in elderly patients, despite its expected increasing use in this population. We conducted a single‐center retrospective case–control study of all patients aged ≥ 75 years who underwent TPE between 2011 and 2023.

pmc-13365990.title: IFPHOR0062 Global Health Promotion and Communication training Curricula: Trends and Structures
pmc-13365990.creator: Allan Ssembuusi, David Musoke, Christine Nalwadda Kayemba, Aisha Nakiwala Sembatya, Marjorie Kyomuhendo, Ivan Lukanda, Agnes Nyabigambo, Rhoda Wanyenze
pmc-13365990.description: IntroductionHealth promotion and communication (HPC) are essential for behaviour change, community empowerment, and effective health information dissemination. However, HPC training opportunities are limited in many low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). This study benchmarked global postgraduate HPC programmes to inform a postgraduate HPC curriculum development at Makerere University, Uganda.

pmc-13409881.title: Towards a Phylogenomic Framework for the Fusarium oxysporum Species Complex
pmc-13409881.creator: Juliana Lopez-Jimenez, Juan M. Daza, Juan F. Alzate
pmc-13409881.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The Fusarium oxysporum species complex (FOSC) is a genetically diverse and globally distributed group of fungi that includes both pathogenic and non-pathogenic lineages with broad host ranges and major agricultural importance. To provide a higher-resolution view of its diversity and evolutionary history, we assembled and quality-filtered genomes, generating a curated dataset of 336 high-quality assemblies complemented by seven NCBI reference genomes (total 343). Orthology inference recovered 4286 conserved single-copy coding sequences, which resolved evolutionary relationships across the complex with high confidence.

pmc-13652674.title: 双歧杆菌三联活菌改善热射病大鼠热耐受性及全身炎症损伤的机制研究
pmc-13652674.creator: Jiangbo XIE, Zhengbiao XUE, Shuchang DING, Peishan WEN, Yanhua WEN, 方 余, 洁 沈
pmc-13652674.description: 目的探究双歧杆菌三联活菌（LCBLE）对热射病大鼠热耐受性的改善作用及对全身炎症损伤的影响，并初步阐明其可能的作用机制。方法大鼠随机分为空白对照组、LCBLE对照组、模型对照组和LCBLE治疗组。LCBLE对照组和LCBLE治疗组于热射病造模前连续7 d灌胃LCBLE，空白对照组和模型对照组予等体积生理盐水；第8天模型对照组和LCBLE治疗组构建热射病模型。监测各组大鼠核心体温、体重及存活率；采用酶联免疫吸附试验检测血清炎症因子和肠型脂肪酸结合蛋白（I-FABP）、乳酸比色法检测D-乳酸、鲎试验法检测内毒素、苏木精-伊红染色观察肠道组织病理损伤形态并评分、免疫荧光染色法检测结肠组织中紧密连接蛋白和上皮钙黏素表达、透射电镜观察结肠上皮组织超微结构；结合16S rRNA测序解析肠道菌群的组成和结构特征。结果与模型对照组比较，LCBLE治疗组可降低核心体温［分别为（43.21±0.33）℃和（42.03±0.43）℃，P<0.01］、缓解体重下降［分别为（286.68±12.61）g和（307.76±11.29）g，P<0.05］、提高存活率（分别为55.6%和77.8%，P<0.05）；LCBLE治疗组血清炎症因子（肿瘤坏死因子α、IL-6、IL-1β）水平降低（均P<0.01），肠道屏障功能障碍相关指标D-乳酸、I-FABP、内毒素水平亦降低（均P<0.05），各肠段组织病理损伤减轻、评分下降（均P<0.01），同时恢复了结肠组织中紧密连接蛋白（紧密连接蛋白1、闭合蛋白）和上皮钙黏素表达及结肠上皮组织超微结构完整性。16S rRNA测序显示，LCBLE可提高大鼠肠道内双歧杆菌属和乳杆菌属的相对丰度。结论LCBLE预防性给药可改善热射病大鼠热耐受性、减轻全身炎症损伤，其机制可能与维持肠道屏障功能、调节肠道菌群有关。Keywords: 热射病, 双歧杆菌三联活菌, 炎症反应, 肠道屏障, 肠道菌群, 大鼠 热射病是在高温高湿环境下机体热平衡调节机制失衡引发的急性重症疾病，常伴随系统性炎症反应综合征，具体表现为促炎性细胞因子风暴、多器官功能障碍甚至衰竭，严重威胁生命健康［1-2］。近年来研究表明，肠道作为人体最大的免疫器官和细菌储存库，在热射病进程中并非被动受累，而是通过“肠-体轴”成为启动和放大全身炎症反应的关键枢纽［3］。正常情况下，肠道菌群通过与宿主的共生关系维持肠道屏障完整性并调节免疫功能；当机体遭遇热射病时，肠黏膜屏障会因缺血-再灌注损伤、氧化应激等因素遭到破坏，导致肠道菌群易位入血，肠道微生物网络结构紊乱，表现为优势菌属丰度下降，条件致病菌过度增殖，进而激活全身免疫系统，诱发或加重系统性炎症反应综合征［4-7］。因此，修复受损的肠道屏障功能、重塑失衡的肠道微生物生态，可能成为提升机体热耐受性、减轻热射病全身炎症损伤的干预方向。 LCBLE作为临床一线微生态调节剂，可通过竞争性排斥、产生抗菌物质、调节黏液分泌等多重机制改善肠道屏障功能，并通过调节Th1与Th2免疫平衡、抑制NF-κB信号通路等途径减轻局部及全身炎症反应［8］。本研究以肠道屏障功能和肠道菌群为切入点，探究LCBLE对热射病大鼠热耐受性及全身炎症损伤的改善作用，并阐明其潜在作用机制，以期为热射病的防治提供新思路。 材料与方法 实验动物、试剂和仪器
